g.text: Range, sensitivity, resolution, accuracy limits, and uncertainty are separate quantities
Illustrative specifications, not a real product. Resolution is the smallest indicated increment; sensitivity is an input–output slope. An accuracy limit
is a specification, not automatically a standard uncertainty. The reported interval follows calibration, corrections and the full uncertainty budget.
